rawRows: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, from 0 to 1, where 0.5 is no better than chance. It summarises every threshold, so it does not state the operating point a product runs at.

Share of unflagged people who do not have the target condition, as a proportion from 0 to 1. It depends on how common the condition is in the people tested, so a value measured in one population does not carry to a population with another prevalence.

Share of flagged people who have the target condition, as a proportion from 0 to 1. It depends on how common the condition is in the people tested, so a value measured in one population does not carry to a population with another prevalence.
Share of people who have the target condition that the product flags, as a proportion from 0 to 1, so 0.85 means 85 percent. Recall and true positive rate are the same quantity.
Share of people without the target condition that the product leaves unflagged, as a proportion from 0 to 1. True negative rate is the same quantity.

A word, not an age. Sources define it differently, so this layer holds no number for it. Compare the lower age bound each source states: study_enrolled_age_min_years for a study, claimed_age_min_years for a vendor claim, intended_age_min_years for a hospital case. A bound that is not stated is unknown and is never read as zero or as everyone.
image acquisition guidance. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.
diagnosis. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the purposes inside it (detection aid, triage notification).
monitoring. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.
prognosis or risk prediction. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.
screening of an unselected population. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.
treatment planning. Broadest term in this hierarchy. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone.
detection aid. Sits inside diagnosis. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the purposes inside it (triage notification). It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.
triage notification. Sits inside detection aid, diagnosis. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

home or remote care. Sits inside any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.

hospital (any unit). Sits inside any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (emergency department, inpatient ward, intensive care unit). It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.

outpatient care (any clinic). Sits inside any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (primary care, urgent care, specialty clinic, eye care, imaging centre). It does not cover a claim for the broader term above it.
emergency department. Sits inside hospital (any unit), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
imaging centre. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
inpatient ward. Sits inside hospital (any unit), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
intensive care unit. Sits inside hospital (any unit), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
primary care. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.

specialty clinic. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it and for the settings inside it (eye care). It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
urgent care. Sits inside outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
eye care. Sits inside specialty clinic, outpatient care (any clinic), any care setting. Evidence established for it covers a claim for it alone. It does not cover a claim for a broader term above it.
